lines.text: SUB BY : DENI AUROR@ https://aurorarental.blogspot.com/ Are you ready, kids?

* who lives in a pineapple under the sea? * * Spongebob Squarepants! * * absorbent and yellow and porous is he. * * Spongebob Squarepants! * * if nautical nonsense be something you wish... * * Spongebob square pants! * * then drop on the deck and flop like a fish. * * Spongebob Squarepants! * * ready? Spongebob Squarepants! * * Spongebob Squarepants!
I'll meet you downstairs and show you around.
Wow! What are you going to do with it?
I'm going to the moon, Spongebob.
No way, Spongebob Especially after your little mishap With my whirlybird.
Besides, there's not enough room for you.
But i don't take up that much space.
Well, how about this, or this, or this?
Spongebob This isn't for fun-- See this?
I don't have time for fun and games And i don't have time for stowaways.
Can i, can i, huh, please?
All right, y'all can ride in the cargo hold If you just...
But this time, just don't touch anything, okay?
Will we hunt aliens on the moon?
This is for harvesting moon rocks.
When you're done playing with rocks You could use that For some serious alien hunting.
How can you be so naive?
How do you explain atlantis, cowlicks, 99-Cent stores?
And how about those mysterious circles That pop up in kelp fields overnight?
Spongebob, you don't know a thing About outer space.
Now, go home and get some shuteye.
Be here tomorrow at the crack of dawn And leave your crazy alien notions behind.
This ought to do the trick.
Can't you see i'm sleeping here?
Well, i know you're going on that moon trip tomorrow And i just wanted to bring you something.
Well, i guess you won't be needing This alien repellent for your trip.
Alien repellent? Let me see that.
Well, i guess you're right, Patrick.
We better go spray those windows.
Look how big it is, Spongebob!
We're just here to spray the windows Patrick.
How do you think we get inside?
This must be the control room.
We can't hang around in here.
This is Sandy's big rocket Not some kind of fun... house.
I don't know, but let's see what this does.
Patrick, i don't think we should...
Wait, i think this one starts it.
I'm the space traveler here And i happen to know that that particular button Is right over here.
Hey, somebody get me down Or up, or something.
Hey, you got your toothpaste In my peanut butter.
Hey, who turned the heavy back on?
Sometimes that Spongebob is as dumb as a sack of peanuts.
Oh, it sure looks a lot like home.
Wait! Don't go near him, Patrick.
Can't you see this is all a trick?
The aliens are projecting our memories Onto the environment.
So you mean to say they've taken what we thought we think And make us think we thought Our thoughts we've been thinking Are thoughts we think we thought?... we think?
Okay, but i'm not going to fall for it.
Sandy... i forgot all about her.
Oh, she's going to hate us for stealing her rocket But won't she feel silly When i bring her back a real, live alien?
Come on, Patrick, the more the merrier.
Shh, Patrick, don't let them know we're on to them.
Uh... yeah, alien hunting-- I saw that on tv, too.
Gee, Patrick, let's drop in On our old pal Squidward And see what he's up to.
Make sure your gun is pumped.
I think i'm going to be sick.
Patrick, do you know what this thing is?
Pardon my french, but get this thing off me!
Patrick and Spongebob, get out of my bedroom And give me back my tentacles.
Up a bit late to be playing pirate, aren't ye?
Okay, okay, shoot me, but don't take me money.
We don't want your money, moon man.
Look at them squirming around in there.
Plenty more where those came from.
Spongebob, what are you doing here so late?
Whatever this is It's going on your permanent record.
Please let me out of here!
Spongebob, i think We might have to make a second trip.
There's no time for that-- Just push harder.
I can't turn my back on you for two seconds Without you causing a whole mess of trouble.
Look at you, bagging up Your friends and neighbors Just like they was a fresh crop Of hickory-Smoked sausages.
You done turned my little science experiment Into a disaster.
You two ought to be ashamed of yourself.
Or should i say, miss alien pants?
Is that what this is about?
Just goes to show you You can't trust anyone.
So... you were an alien all the time And you didn't even tell me.
Yeah? Well, i got you now.
Oh, but it's not you that's got me; it's...
Boy, i can't wait to see the look on Sandy's face.
We "aliens" would like a word with you.
* pearl is my daughter, i'll spit in your eye. * * oh, ho, pearl's a whale, and it's her birthday. * Ta-Dah!
Now can we open the presents?
Presents for me darling little sardine.
It wouldn't be those totally hip new flipper slippers All my friends wear.
I mean, dad, you really shouldn't have.
Pearl, those are the finest fishing boots available.
But i got them for a bargain.
Oh, what am i going to do?
I spent two whole dollars on these boots And now i'm stuck with them.
Oh, uh, Mister Krabs, can i get my paycheck?
Come in, come in, right this way, laddie.
Have a seat anywhere But not on these beautiful, priceless boots.
Uh, sir, i can't see you.
The boots... are in... the way.
These boots never leave my sight.
They're the most expensive and prized possessions i own.
They look just like any old ordinary boots.
These are the only official fry cook boots.
Only the finest fry cooks in the world Are permitted to wear them-- Part of a tradition.
And these boots were given to me By the most famous fry cook in the sea.
Uh... well, his name is not important.
But he was famous all right, don't you worry.
* i'm ready, i'm ready, i want those boots! * Sorry, son, these boots are far too valuable.
What if i give you my krusty krab paycheck?
And what if i paint the krusty krab for free?
And i'll throw in A year's supply of french fry oil.
Hold on there You're going to give me a heart attack.
Whoa... you got yourself a deal.
Do you like my new boots?
Now i'm an official fry cook.
That squeaking is going to drive us all crazy!
That squeaking is money to my ears... i mean music.
Ah... money, money, money, money, money.
What the barnacle is that, huh?
Argh... that was the worst night i ever weathered.
At least i'll have some peace and quiet at work.
I can't take the world's greatest fry cook anymore!
I'll see you in a week.
That fry cook Is making me a fortune.
I, uh, see you're still wearing them boots.
Could the world's greatest fry cook do this?
Well, uh, i don't, uh... i don't, uh...
Yeah, i'll have the krusty special.
We will squeak when it's ready.
Could the greatest fry cook do that, Mister Krabs?
And look at this, Mister Krabs.
And this... and this... and this...
And this... and this... and this... and this...
I got to go to my office!
Those boots have got to go!
Gary, these boots Have changed my life.
Ar, ar, ar, ar, ar, ar...
Oh, Mister Krabs, i'm sorry, sorry, sorry, i'm sorry.
I lost the boots, your valuable boots.
Hold it, boy, it's not the end of the world.
You were right-- I wasn't ready for those blessed boots.
I heard his order, Mister Krabs.
Could the world's greatest fry cook do this?
And this... and this... and this... and this...
Yes, i did it! I did it!
It's the squeaking of the hideous boots!
I'm sorry, but i can't take the infernal squeaking no more!
Um... why did you eat my boots, Mister Krabs?
Because, lad, you didn't need them.
It's not the boots, it's the bootee, uh...
I mean the person in the boots.
You really think so, Mister Krabs?
Here's your paycheck i owe you Plus a bonus.
Ah... a long week away from bikini bottom Is exactly what i need.
Just me and my darling daughter pearl.
Oh, don't forget my new flipper slippers, daddy.
